description.value: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Gehenna.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses [[/item .WRuHGpUpZBTE6CJj]] and makes two [[/item .z7YCggCfAsVvGLe4]] attacks.

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can teleport the target up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see that isn't in the air.

Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=q6lj2gDCJZRDwrr6]], each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: [[/damage 3d6 average type=psychic]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Hypnotic Gaze for 24 hours.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDimensionD]{Dimension Door}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFireball00]{Fireball} (level 5 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWallofFire]{Wall of Fire}
